name: AV authorisation conditions: onboard safety driver or safety operator
value_original: LTA may impose any condition; listed: (b) qualified safety driver seated in the AV to monitor and take over; (c) qualified safety operator to monitor and take over; (d) no passengers; (e) no hire or reward
inclusions: Official legal text (typed statistic for lack of a regulation type). Conditions are set case by case per authorisation (r.9(1), r.9(3))
applicability: Singapore; all AV trials/special uses under Road Traffic Act s.6C-6E until the planned AV Act (MOT: to be tabled 2027)
title: Road Traffic (Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017, rule 9 (S 464/2017, version 14 Feb 2024)

name: AV authorisation fee
inclusions: Statutory fee per vehicle per authorisation (r.7(2)(a), amended S 89/2024 wef 14 Feb 2024); plus road tax-equivalent if vehicle unregistered (r.7(2)(b)); fee can be waived (r.7(3))
conversion: Nominal statutory fee in force in 2026; no CPI uplift
applicability: Negligible against other costs; excludes CETRAN testing, assessment and consultancy costs, which are not published
title: Road Traffic (Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017, rule 7

name: Mandatory AV liability insurance
value_original: Liability insurance in place before and throughout the trial/use, from an insurer lawfully carrying on insurance business in Singapore (r.14); meaning as RTA s.6C(6)
inclusions: Requirement only; no premium level is published
applicability: Singapore AV sandbox; premium must be priced from market evidence or assumption
title: Road Traffic (Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017, rule 14

name: Security deposit in lieu of liability insurance
value_original: 1500000 (minimum)
inclusions: Deposit allowed only if insurance cannot be obtained despite reasonable efforts (r.15(1)); used to pay court orders/settlements; must be topped up within 14 days (r.15(4))
conversion: Nominal statutory minimum; not a premium. Annual cost = opportunity cost, e.g. 1.5M x 3% real = SGD 45,000/yr per authorisation
applicability: Programme-level alternative, not per vehicle; caps nothing (liability is unlimited)
title: Road Traffic (Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017, rule 15

name: Data recorder and 3-year data retention duty
value_original: Recorder on all the time; >=2 Hz position and speed; mode (manual/autonomous/teleoperation); override history; sensor data; internal and external camera footage; keep >=3 years in LTA format (r.17)
inclusions: Requirement only; drives data storage and upload cost
applicability: Singapore AV sandbox; cost not published
title: Road Traffic (Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017, rule 17

name: Safety operator (SO) vs remote operator (RO) in the Singapore framework
value_original: Under the current Deployment Readiness Assessment phase an SO remains on board while remote operations are tested; ROs expected to be deployed in lieu of SOs upon full deployment; one RO may oversee several AVs (1:N) conditional on technical and operational readiness; SO and RO run concurrently only during the assessment phase
inclusions: Government consultation paper (official statement of current practice and intended direction); no ratio N given
applicability: Singapore; describes current pilots (SO on board) and intended future arrangement (RO 1:N); AV Act planned for 2027
title: Consultation Paper on the Regulatory and Legal Framework for Autonomous Vehicles (AV) in Singapore (Introduction para 2c-d, footnote 3; Chapter A para 7)

name: AV insurance regime and premium risk
value_original: Authorisation holders must hold liability insurance; regime fault-based (Motor Accident Guide, BOLA); additional risk and uncertainty "would translate to higher insurance premiums"; self-insurance and cyber-payout caps under study
inclusions: Official consultation; no premium figures
applicability: Singapore; supports a wide insurance range
